theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (m : Measure ↥U) (ν₁ : ↥U → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ K : Set ↥U, IsCompact K → m K < ∞) → Measurable ν₁ → (∀ y, ‖ν₁ y‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ᵐ y ∂m, ‖ν₁ y‖ = 1) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ν : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Measurable ν ∧ μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ x, ‖ν x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (f x) (ν x)) μ ∧ ∫ x, inner ℝ (f x) (ν x) ∂μ = ∫ y, inner ℝ (f ↑y) (ν₁ y) ∂m
